args.sql:
SELECT
    e.equipmentcode AS equipment,
    ce.heaterstatus AS heater_status,
    tswg.insulationstatus AS insulation_status,
    las.emergencylightstatus AS emergency_light_status,
    ws.structuralloadpercent AS structure_margin,
    om.operationalstatus AS readiness_label
FROM
    equipment e
JOIN
    cabinenvironment ce ON e.equipmentcode = ce.cabineqref
JOIN
    thermalsolarwindandgrid tswg ON e.equipmentcode = tswg.thermaleqref
JOIN
    lightingandsafety las ON e.equipmentcode = las.lighteqref
JOIN
    weatherandstructure ws ON e.equipmentcode = ws.weatherlocref
JOIN
    operationmaintenance om ON e.equipmentcode = om.opmainteqref
WHERE
    ce.heaterstatus = 'On'
    AND tswg.insulationstatus = 'Good'
    AND las.emergencylightstatus = 'On'
    AND ws.structuralintegritystatus = 'Normal'
    AND om.operationalstatus = 'Active';
